AttributeDefId.description: An attribute definition's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

AttributeValues.description: Values of attributes, by their attribute definitions' IDs, each of its definition's type.

attributes.description: A value of each of the attribute definitions of the component's type, by the definition's ID, of its type.

image.description: The component's image. Its file is the snapshot's assets/<the ID's body>.<its extension> when the snapshot includes assets. Without it, the component has none.

key.description: The key by which expressions name the component, unique among the project's.

ComponentId.description: A component's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

ComponentTypeId.description: A component type's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Components.description: A snapshot's project/components.json: the components, with their values (PRD §6.3).

schemaVersion.description: The version of the published format, 1.

Value.description: A value, which its declaration's type says how to read, never its JSON form (PRD §5.8.9): a boolean, a number, or a string.
